title: cost --research: tokens per closed gap
goal: backlog.py cost --research joins research items' tokens to the gap findings closed by commits with their KB-Work trailer.

gates.question: What single figure is an item's tokens in cost --research?
options: in + cw + cr + out of its direct + attributed counts (requests and cw1h not added)
in + cw + out, cache reads left out
no single figure: per-model rows only
gates.recommendation: in + cw + cr + out of its direct + attributed counts (requests and cw1h not added)
gates.answer: in + cw + cr + out of its direct + attributed counts (requests and cw1h not added)

gates.question: Which commits close a gap finding for an item in cost --research?
options: a commit with the item's KB-Work trailer whose _gaps.md gains a Resolved or Superseded note under the entry naming the finding
a commit with the item's KB-Work trailer whose message names the finding id
the commit that records the finding at stage claim (querylog.py close), which has no KB-Work trailer
gates.recommendation: a commit with the item's KB-Work trailer whose _gaps.md gains a Resolved or Superseded note under the entry naming the finding
gates.answer: a commit with the item's KB-Work trailer whose _gaps.md gains a Resolved or Superseded note under the entry naming the finding

gates.question: Does an item's row count its descendants' tokens and trailers?
options: own lines and own trailer only; a qualifying descendant has its own row
the item and its descendants, as cost ID does
gates.recommendation: own lines and own trailer only; a qualifying descendant has its own row
gates.answer: own lines and own trailer only; a qualifying descendant has its own row
